P.name: Spirit Abjuration
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurora's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Spirit Abjuration'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|90+10*x}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description2: Upon consuming the stacks from a {{tip|champion}}, '''Aurora''' additionally exorcises them, freeing a {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, '''Aurora''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} for {{pplevel|2 + x|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 2% AP)}} every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} and refresh all active {{as|Spirits|buzzword}}. '''Aurora''' may have up to 4 {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of {{pplevel|(2 + x)*4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*4}}% AP)}}.

Q.name: Twofold Hex
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and marks them with a curse for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: ''Twofold Hex'' can be recast after {{fd|0.1}} seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurora''' expunges the curse from all marked targets, drawing the spiritual energy back to her as bolts that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}} and 50% against {{tip|monsters}} and increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100*(1.5-1) for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula={{#expr:1.5-1}}% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal {{ap|0.2*100}}% damage.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 145}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Bolt Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*0.2 to 145*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Bolt Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5*0.2 to 145*1.5*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5*0.2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Across the Veil
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|hops}} in the target direction inside a portal to the Spirit Realm. Upon {{tt|completing|See notes}} the dash, she becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration and gains ''Realm Hopper'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Realm Hopper:}} '''Aurora''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration.
W.description3: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset ''Across the Veil's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

E.name: The Weirding
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' blasts energy in a line in the target direction and {{tip|dash|recoils}} 250 units in the opposite direction. The blast deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for 1 second decaying after the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds.

R.name: Between Worlds
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She then gains ''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' for a duration and unleashes a shockwave from {{tt|425 units|Estimated}} in front of her, expanding over {{fd|0.75}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|175 to 375}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' Duration|{{ap|3.5 to 5}} seconds}}
R.description2: The shockwave leaves behind a circular rift to the Spirit Realm for a duration, forming borders that interact with '''Aurora''' and enemies. If '''Aurora''' {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, she {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the diametrically opposite side of the rift over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the travel. If an enemy {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for a duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Rift Duration|{{ap|2.5-0.75 to 4-0.75}} seconds<!-- Duration w/o the creation time. See notes -->}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1.5 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description3: ''Between Worlds'' can be recast after 1 second of unleashing the shockwave while the rift is active.
R.description5: ''The rift closes immediately if '''Aurora''' {{tip|death|dies}}, enters {{tip|resurrection}}, leaves the area, or is not within the area upon creation.''
